민수기 33:1.content: These are the journeys of the children of Israel, which went forth out of the land of Egypt with their armies under the hand of Moses and Aaron.

민수기 33:2.content: And Moses wrote their goings out according to their journeys by the commandment of the Lord: and these are their journeys according to their goings out.

민수기 33:3.content: And they departed from Rameses in the first month, on the fifteenth day of the first month; on the morrow after the passover the children of Israel went out with an high hand in the sight of all the Egyptians.

민수기 33:4.content: For the Egyptians buried all their firstborn, which the Lord had smitten among them: upon their gods also the Lord executed judgments.

민수기 33:5.content: And the children of Israel removed from Rameses, and pitched in Succoth.

민수기 33:6.content: And they departed from Succoth, and pitched in Etham, which is in the edge of the wilderness.

민수기 33:7.content: And they removed from Etham, and turned again unto Pi–hahiroth, which is before Baal–zephon: and they pitched before Migdol.

민수기 33:8.content: And they departed from before Pi–hahiroth, and passed through the midst of the sea into the wilderness, and went three days’ journey in the wilderness of Etham, and pitched in Marah.

민수기 33:9.content: And they removed from Marah, and came unto Elim: and in Elim were twelve fountains of water, and threescore and ten palm trees; and they pitched there.

민수기 33:10.content: And they removed from Elim, and encamped by the Red sea.

민수기 33:11.content: And they removed from the Red sea, and encamped in the wilderness of Sin.

민수기 33:12.content: And they took their journey out of the wilderness of Sin, and encamped in Dophkah.

민수기 33:13.content: And they departed from Dophkah, and encamped in Alush.

민수기 33:14.content: And they removed from Alush, and encamped at Rephidim, where was no water for the people to drink.

민수기 33:15.content: And they departed from Rephidim, and pitched in the wilderness of Sinai.

민수기 33:16.content: And they removed from the desert of Sinai, and pitched at Kibroth–hattaavah.

민수기 33:17.content: And they departed from Kibroth–hattaavah, and encamped at Hazeroth.

민수기 33:18.content: And they departed from Hazeroth, and pitched in Rithmah.

민수기 33:19.content: And they departed from Rithmah, and pitched at Rimmon–parez.

민수기 33:20.content: And they departed from Rimmon–parez, and pitched in Libnah.

민수기 33:21.content: And they removed from Libnah, and pitched at Rissah.

민수기 33:22.content: And they journeyed from Rissah, and pitched in Kehelathah.

민수기 33:23.content: And they went from Kehelathah, and pitched in mount Shapher.

민수기 33:24.content: And they removed from mount Shapher, and encamped in Haradah.

민수기 33:25.content: And they removed from Haradah, and pitched in Makheloth.

민수기 33:26.content: And they removed from Makheloth, and encamped at Tahath.

민수기 33:27.content: And they departed from Tahath, and pitched at Tarah.

민수기 33:28.content: And they removed from Tarah, and pitched in Mithcah.

민수기 33:29.content: And they went from Mithcah, and pitched in Hashmonah.

민수기 33:30.content: And they departed from Hashmonah, and encamped at Moseroth.

민수기 33:31.content: And they departed from Moseroth, and pitched in Bene–jaakan.

민수기 33:32.content: And they removed from Bene–jaakan, and encamped at Hor–hagidgad.

민수기 33:33.content: And they went from Hor–hagidgad, and pitched in Jotbathah.

민수기 33:34.content: And they removed from Jotbathah, and encamped at Ebronah.

민수기 33:35.content: And they departed from Ebronah, and encamped at Ezion–gaber.

민수기 33:36.content: And they removed from Ezion–gaber, and pitched in the wilderness of Zin, which is Kadesh.

민수기 33:37.content: And they removed from Kadesh, and pitched in mount Hor, in the edge of the land of Edom.

민수기 33:38.content: And Aaron the priest went up into mount Hor at the commandment of the Lord, and died there, in the fortieth year after the children of Israel were come out of the land of Egypt, in the first day of the fifth month.

민수기 33:39.content: And Aaron was an hundred and twenty and three years old when he died in mount Hor.

민수기 33:40.content: And king Arad the Canaanite, which dwelt in the south in the land of Canaan, heard of the coming of the children of Israel.

민수기 33:41.content: And they departed from mount Hor, and pitched in Zalmonah.

민수기 33:42.content: And they departed from Zalmonah, and pitched in Punon.

민수기 33:43.content: And they departed from Punon, and pitched in Oboth.

민수기 33:44.content: And they departed from Oboth, and pitched in Ije–abarim, in the border of Moab.

민수기 33:45.content: And they departed from Iim, and pitched in Dibon–gad.

민수기 33:46.content: And they removed from Dibon–gad, and encamped in Almon–diblathaim.

민수기 33:47.content: And they removed from Almon–diblathaim, and pitched in the mountains of Abarim, before Nebo.

민수기 33:48.content: And they departed from the mountains of Abarim, and pitched in the plains of Moab by Jordan near Jericho.

민수기 33:49.content: And they pitched by Jordan, from Beth–jesimoth even unto Abel–shittim in the plains of Moab.

민수기 33:50.content: And the Lord spake unto Moses in the plains of Moab by Jordan near Jericho, saying,

민수기 33:51.content: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, When ye are passed over Jordan into the land of Canaan;

민수기 33:52.content: Then ye shall drive out all the inhabitants of the land from before you, and destroy all their pictures, and destroy all their molten images, and quite pluck down all their high places:

민수기 33:53.content: And ye shall dispossess the inhabitants of the land, and dwell therein: for I have given you the land to possess it.

민수기 33:54.content: And ye shall divide the land by lot for an inheritance among your families: and to the more ye shall give the more inheritance, and to the fewer ye shall give the less inheritance: every man’s inheritance shall be in the place where his lot falleth; according to the tribes of your fathers ye shall inherit.

민수기 33:55.content: But if ye will not drive out the inhabitants of the land from before you; then it shall come to pass, that those which ye let remain of them shall be pricks in your eyes, and thorns in your sides, and shall vex you in the land wherein ye dwell.

민수기 33:56.content: Moreover it shall come to pass, that I shall do unto you, as I thought to do unto them.
